explanation.summary: For each name on record, show the call-side net premium against the put-side net premium for each recorded trading day, with the difference between the two sides.

net_words: Every figure on this board is a net premium figure for one side of the options trades on record: money taken in on prints judged bought minus money paid out on prints judged sold, for calls and for puts separately. The record carries net figures per side only: there is no gross split on record, so this board shows no gross buying or gross selling figure.
